mapper.sql: id, owner_account_id, preparation_id, request_key, expected_revision, status, stage, result_json, failure_code, failure_message, failure_detail_json, created_at, finished_at, seen_at
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM account WHERE id = #{ownerId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND suspended_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM application_document_generation_job WHERE owner_account_id = #{ownerId} AND request_key = #{requestKey}
SELECT FROM application_document_generation_job WHERE preparation_id = #{preparationId} AND active_slot = 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM application_document_generation_job WHERE owner_account_id = #{ownerId} AND active_slot = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO application_document_generation_job (owner_account_id, preparation_id, request_key, expected_revision, created_at) VALUES (#{ownerAccountId}, #{preparationId}, #{requestKey}, #{expectedRevision}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM application_document_generation_job WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_account_id = #{ownerId} AND preparation_id = #{preparationId}
SELECT FROM application_document_generation_job WHERE owner_account_id = #{ownerId} AND preparation_id = #{preparationId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT FROM application_document_generation_job WHERE owner_account_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT id FROM application_document_generation_job WHERE status = 'QUEUED' AND created_at > DATE_SUB(#{now}, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE application_document_generation_job j INNER JOIN account a ON a.id = j.owner_account_id SET j.status = 'RUNNING', j.stage = 'PREPARING', j.started_at = #{now} WHERE j.id = #{id} AND j.status = 'QUEUED' AND j.created_at > DATE_SUB(#{now}, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.suspended_at IS NULL
UPDATE application_document_generation_job SET stage = #{stage} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND started_at > DATE_SUB(#{now}, INTERVAL 30 MINUTE)
UPDATE application_document_generation_job SET ai_started_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND ai_started_at IS NULL AND started_at > DATE_SUB(#{now}, INTERVAL 30 MINUTE)

UPDATE application_document_generation_job SET status = #{status}, result_json = #{resultJson}, failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, failure_detail_json = #{failureDetailJson}, finished_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND started_at > DATE_SUB(#{now}, INTERVAL 30 MINUTE)

UPDATE application_document_generation_job j INNER JOIN account a ON a.id = j.owner_account_id SET j.status = 'FAILED', j.failure_code = CASE WHEN a.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR a.suspended_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'ACCOUNT_INACTIVE' ELSE 'QUEUE_EXPIRED' END, j.failure_message = '문서 생성 작업이 시작되지 못해 만료됐습니다. 다시 만들기를 눌러 주세요.', j.finished_at = #{now} WHERE j.status = 'QUEUED' AND (j.created_at <= DATE_SUB(#{now}, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) OR a.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR a.suspended_at IS NOT NULL)

UPDATE application_document_generation_job SET status = CASE WHEN ai_started_at IS NULL THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END, failure_code = CASE WHEN ai_started_at IS NULL THEN 'RUN_INTERRUPTED' ELSE 'RUN_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN' END, failure_message = CASE WHEN ai_started_at IS NULL THEN '문서 생성이 중간에 멈췄습니다. 답변은 저장되어 있으니 다시 시도해 주세요.' ELSE '문서 생성 결과를 확인하지 못했습니다. 저장된 문서 목록을 확인한 뒤 필요하면 다시 만들어 주세요.' END, finished_at = #{now} WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND started_at <= DATE_SUB(#{now}, INTERVAL 30 MINUTE)

UPDATE application_document_generation_job SET status = 'FAILED', failure_code = 'RUN_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN_EXPIRED' WHERE status = 'UNKNOWN' AND finished_at <= DATE_SUB(#{now}, INTERVAL #{ttlSeconds} SECOND)
